quests.title: Optional: Beyond the Ink
quests.text: The crown's chart of Stormscale Summit, {dir_from_giver:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore} across the water, has more empty space than I'm comfortable signing. Take a boat from the coast; the Shipwright at the stables sells them. Follow the shelf and the channel to avoid the Kraken in deep water, then defeat six Last Watchmen on the {name:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore} after dark. I'd like the next expedition to find somewhere to land, and you to come home to your payment.
quests.lesson: Island trip by boat; coin at the cap, no XP.

quests.title: Party: An Unrequested Audience
quests.text: {name:last_offering_ape} receives visitors in the {name:front_stormscale_summit/thunderwood} {dir_from_giver:last_offering_ape}, and the survivors describe an appalling welcome. Take a full party by boat to Stormscale Summit and defeat that elite ape. For once, the crown is prepared to reward a complete failure of diplomacy.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite on the island.

quests.title: Bounty: Fashion at a Safe Distance
quests.text: The court tailors have discovered Silver Mane, and their enthusiasm survives every description of the journey. Take a boat to Stormscale Summit and collect four tufts from Mandrills in the {name:front_stormscale_summit/thunderwood} by day. Bring them to me for payment; I handle the purse so you needn't hear about hems. This bounty is available again one hour after each turn-in.
quests.lesson: Island salvage bounty: coin at the cap.

quests.title: Optional: A Chest Overboard
quests.text: The wreck at {name:r20_anchor_086} on Stormscale Summit holds a chest of branded pay that some fortunate salvager will mistake for wages. Reach it by boat from the Shipwright at the stables, keeping to the shelf and channel away from the Kraken's deep water. Give the wreck's pay to the sea before anyone accepts it; I can defend the loss of a chest more easily than the loss of its next crew.

objectives.label: Give the wreck's pay to the sea

quests.lesson: Optional island extension of the main line (chapter 3 on): one use, coin only.
